original notes when I posted the raw waves Sep 5 2021 and I wasn't quite used to going to shows:



Sound varies. I don't listen to any of these bands but a friend is playing in 1 of them and thought it would be cool to see him play in a stadium. Ate an infused cookie and melted into my seat. My new favorite summertime activity - take an edible at a random stadium show and watch the lights, pyro and people. Doesn't matter who is playing really. Then got lost on the way out with 100mg plus of THC coursing thru my blood only find myself abandoned by my friend and unable to find my way out of the parking lot.

If not for a conflicting event I would totally go see Aventura at Dodger Stadium tonight.

If not for the pandemic I might have never even noticed it was legal now!
